brief:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said his Labour government will pursue a two-state solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict with principle, according to Middle East Eye. Burnham made the statement Tuesday during his first speech to parliament as prime minister, signaling Labour's commitment to the longstanding diplomatic framework.

The remarks come as Britain continues efforts to shape Middle East peace negotiations alongside international partners seeking resolution to the decades-long conflict between Israelis and Palestinians.

title: British PM pledges principled approach to two-state solution
